title: Southeast Florida’s Premier Waterfront Restaurants You Can Arrive To by Yacht
description: Discover the top yacht-accessible waterfront restaurants in Southeast Florida, where gourmet dining meets the luxury of a seaside arrival. From Miami to Palm Beach, explore premier dock-and-dine experiences tailored for yacht owners.
html:
A Culinary Voyage Along the Coast

For yacht owners cruising the crystal-clear waters of Southeast Florida, the journey is as much about indulgence as it is about exploration. Imagine pulling up to a dock, stepping off your vessel, and walking straight into a waterfront restaurant where world-class cuisine and oceanfront views await. In this guide, we highlight some of Florida’s finest yacht-friendly restaurants, where luxury and leisure come together with unforgettable flavors.

Seaspice Brasserie & Lounge

1. Seaspice Brasserie & Lounge – Miami River, Miami

Set on the banks of the Miami River, Seaspice offers an upscale yet relaxed atmosphere that’s become a favorite among the yachting elite. With a full-service marina at hand, docking is seamless. Diners enjoy globally influenced seafood dishes like Dover sole and Chilean sea bass, all with a backdrop of the downtown skyline and passing superyachts.

Dockage Tip: Call ahead for slip availability, especially on weekends.

2. Le Tub Saloon – Hollywood

This hidden gem in Hollywood is a laid-back contrast to glitzier locales but has earned a cult following for its award-winning burgers and funky décor. Located right off the Intracoastal Waterway, Le Tub offers convenient docking and casual charm — ideal for a low-key afternoon after a morning on the water.

Don’t Miss: The 13-ounce sirloin burger, once named the best in the country by GQ Magazine.

Kaluz

3. Kaluz – Fort Lauderdale

Located just north of the 17th Street Causeway, Kaluz is one of Fort Lauderdale’s premier dining destinations, offering New American cuisine in a refined, contemporary setting. The waterside patio offers direct dockage, making it a favorite stop for boaters heading up the Intracoastal.

Signature Dish: Grilled octopus and the house-cut ribeye.

4. Guanabanas – Jupiter

Nestled among lush tropical landscaping and tiki huts, Guanabanas offers a true island escape in the heart of Jupiter. It’s accessible by boat from the Loxahatchee River and offers a casual, open-air experience with Caribbean-inspired dishes and craft cocktails.

Yachter’s Note: Docking can fill up quickly during lunch hours—plan to arrive early.

Waterstone Rum Bar & Grill

5. Waterstone Rum Bar & Grill – Boca Raton

Attached to the Waterstone Resort, this sleek and modern venue offers stunning views of Lake Boca and the Atlantic Ocean inlet. The dock accommodates small to mid-sized vessels, and the menu features Latin coastal fare and premium rum cocktails, perfect for a sunset toast.

Local Favorite: Coconut ceviche paired with a pineapple mojito.

The Dock-and-Dine Lifestyle

Dining by yacht isn’t just about convenience — it’s a lifestyle choice that reflects the finer things in life: luxury, freedom, and a taste for the exceptional. Southeast Florida offers no shortage of destinations where you can tie off your lines and enjoy a gourmet meal steps from your deck. Whether you’re in the market for a yacht or already navigating the coast, these restaurants invite you to savor every nautical mile.
